subject: How to create a shinystan object from a pyStan StanFit4Model

messages.author: acb035971cfe69ff
messages.subject: How to create a shinystan object from a pyStan StanFit4Model
parts:
Basically I fit stan model with python (jupyter notebook) and want to display the result for model checking with R shinystan. The difficulty is that result of fitting from pyStan is StanFit4Model which can not be converted into shinystan object directly and can also not be passed into R either by %%R code magic in jupyter notebook or dump+reload.

Is there anyway to make pyStan and shinystan cooperate with each other?

messages.author: 6037c7a8928be573
messages.subject: Re: How to create a shinystan object from a pyStan StanFit4Model
parts: You have to pull the simulation draws out of your python object, port it to R as a data frame directly or as a CSV file, and then put it into the array format that shinystan uses (explained in the documentation). Then it should work, although I don't think you would have access to the NUTS specific information such as divergences and energy.

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: How to create a shinystan object from a pyStan StanFit4Model
parts:
What Bob K said is right, although in the most recent release of shinystan (v2.3.0) there's a way for you to still get the NUTS specific information (albeit with a bit of effort) even if not using one of rstan's stanfit object. Check out the syntax in the example given at https://github.com/stan-dev/shinystan/pull/143. You'd have to put the NUTS information that you import from Python into the right format, but the right format is the same as the format used by RStan for the sampler parameters so you can use that as a guide. 

Hope that helps,

Jonah
